description: One 50-second grasp-and-place task per simple-PnP scene
success_condition: object_resting_in_container: released, bin-supported and pose-stable for 0.5 seconds

filtering.exclusion_rule: All episodes of tasks that fell or had asset scale replaced, plus user-excluded targets (birdhouse, brick, coffee_can, cubebox_a02, dumbbell, metalfstylecan_a01, wood_block); geometry warnings alone do not exclude a task.
